name: algoflix-root
description: One-command launcher for AlgoFlix full-stack platform

scripts.start: concurrently -n "SERVER,CLIENT" -c "red,cyan" "npm.cmd run dev --prefix server" "npm.cmd run dev --prefix client"
scripts.dev: concurrently -n "SERVER,CLIENT" -c "red,cyan" "npm.cmd run dev --prefix server" "npm.cmd run dev --prefix client"
scripts.install:all: npm.cmd install && npm.cmd install --prefix server && npm.cmd install --prefix client
